description: Retrieval A/B evaluation set for spec §18.7. Every case is grounded in the real corpus at data/sources/*.md (verified by reading the actual document text on 2026-08-06, not invented). Consumed by scripts/retrieval_ab_test.py.

categoryNotes.answerable: The corpus contains a real, verifiable answer.
categoryNotes.error_code: Query names a real error code/message that literally appears in a source document.
categoryNotes.no_answer: The topic is genuinely absent from the corpus (verified by grep across data/sources/*.md before adding); a correct system must say so, not fabricate.
categoryNotes.acl: Exercises the ACL / allowed_groups path. NOTE: the shipped corpus (data/metadata.json is not present, only metadata.example.json) has no document with a real allowed_groups restriction, so every 'acl' case here only proves the documented default ('empty allowed_groups = visible to all groups') holds for two different group sets. A true allow/deny contrast case is a known gap - see docs/retrieval-ab-test-report.md.
categoryNotes.image: The cited document has a real image under data/assets/ that chunk_markdown()/extract_images() actually attaches to the matching chunk.

cases.query: VPN連線出現 Error -619，這是什麼問題？
cases.notes: VPN常見Q&A問答.md only documents -455, -14, -8 and the license/OTP/server-address cases -- -619 does not appear (verified via grep -o). This checks the system does not guess/generalize an undocumented error code just because the doc topic (VPN) matches.
